doc.title: Frank Wess — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: The Thad Jones tribute recording "One More"
summary: Wess and Sara Tsutsumi try to recall who organized and played on the 2005 Thad Jones tribute recordings.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: And speaking of Thad, in 2005 there’s a recording called, “One More: The Music of Thad Jones.” Do you recall that recording?
No, who was that with?
I don’t know who else was on it, actually. It’s a collection of various musicians paying tribute to Thad
Oh yeah, wait a minute, yeah! I think that was…maybe Benny Golson was on one of those.
That sounds right.
Maybe Jimmy Owens and Eddie Daniels. Yeah I remember that, that was nice. I never got a chance to play some of Thad’s music.
And who organized that?
I don’t know, really.
That was Doug Louier right? He was the person who paid for the recording.
You have to remember that person if they paid for it. Don’t forget that name.

No, well I don’t know. The musical director for the thing’s name was Patterson. But I don’t really remember who did what to whom. (Laughs) But I do remember doing it. I think we might have done two of those.
Yes, two!
Volume one and volume two.
Yes, I think maybe we did…yes. I think Moody was on one, possibly.
Yes, Moody and Richard Davis maybe? Mickey Roker?
Probably Mickey Roker, I can’t remember.
Do remember the recording circumstance? Where were you when you were recording that?
I’ve forgotten
I think it was at a factory, no?
Maybe, I can’t remember just where it was.
